programs.title: The Torture Chamber of Dr. Sadism
programs.desc: A revived nobleman who took the lives of 12 young women to live forever is out to get revenge on the daughter of the woman meant to be his 13th victim and the son of the legal official who sentenced him.

programs.title: Wedding Bells
programs.desc: Two people with commitment issues are asked to be best man and maid of honour at their friends' wedding. With nothing much in common, they didn't expect to find the romance of a life time.

programs.title: Cup of Love
programs.desc: A flavour scientist of a large coffee chain's sent to Colombia where she meets a farmer, and a romance brews.

programs.title: Before You Say I Do
programs.desc: George's fiancee regrets due to a bad marriage 10 years ago. George wishes that he could change things and suddenly finds himself 10 years back in time - days before the wedding. Can he change things?

programs.title: A Hazard of Hearts
programs.desc: When compulsive gambler Sir Giles Staverley (Christopher Plummer) has lost his estate and all of his money playing dice, he realizes that he only has one thing left of value: his daughter Serena (Helena Bonham Carter). In a final game, he stakes his daughter's hand in marriage, convinced that this time he will not lose. Unfortunately, however, he does lose; to the evil Lord Harry Wrotham (Edward Fox).

programs.title: An American Rhapsody
programs.desc: A young Hungarian girl has a hard time figuring out where she belongs when she finally joins her parents in the USA. They had left her behind when they escaped from their communist country in the 1950s.
